strategy.summary: axe-core found no violations on `/` and `/contact`, and no e2e test runs axe on them yet. Add an axe check (via @axe-core/playwright, which is already a devDependency) to the existing home and contact spec files. Each check fails on any violation rated minor or worse, and its failure message lists each rule and the elements it failed on.
inScope: A shared helper, tests/support/axe.js, that runs axe and formats the violations, used by both specs
outOfScope: Known violations on /about (color-contrast) and /cart (image-alt): earlier runs already reported them, and the ticket says to leave them
Keyboard and screen-reader behaviour, which axe can't check
assumptions: The real app runs from server.js through Playwright's webServer on port 4174; nothing is faked
The axe check gets a new test in each page's existing spec file. The existing journey tests stay unchanged, with every assertion kept
The scan runs every axe rule, with no withTags restriction and no rule disabled, to match the sweep that found these pages clean
